page.overview:
Who is Correl?

Correl was the second known king of Cintra and the son of King Cerbin and Queen Becca of Nazair. He married Eschiva of Sodden with whom he had 3 children: Cirra of Cintra, Ceran, and Coram I, who later inherited his father's throne.
